comparison: Baseline (76 features) vs NF-Standardized (21 NetFlow features)

cross_dataset.failure_mode: Model collapsed to Infilteration class due to 55 zero-filled features
Still poor generalization despite all features matched — indicates semantic gap between CICFlowMeter and NetFlow feature extraction, not just schema mismatch

analysis.key_finding: NF-standardization eliminated zero-filling but did NOT improve cross-dataset generalization (ToN-IoT F1 dropped from 0.0427 to 0.0304). This proves the generalization failure is NOT caused by feature schema mismatch alone — the underlying feature distributions between CICFlowMeter and NetFlow/IPFIX extractors are fundamentally different. The model learned CICFlowMeter-specific statistical patterns, not universal semantic attack behavior.
analysis.implication: Cross-dataset generalization requires domain adaptation techniques beyond feature alignment — e.g., adversarial domain adaptation, feature distribution normalization, or training on multi-source data.
